# #308 — ob-memory-provider: public receipt strips all failure detail — spooled/failed are undiagnosable without hand-invoking the venv

## Problem

The Claude direct-provider adapter (`_ob/scripts/ob-memory-provider/ob-memory-provider.ts` in Development, content-addressed under `~/.local/share/openbrain-memory/adapters/versions/`) deliberately emits a content-free public receipt. Good instinct — but it strips the package receipt's `error` field entirely, so `status:"spooled"` and `status:"failed"` carry zero diagnostic signal.

Live case (2026-07-20, core01 0.1.9 rollout): captures returned `{"status":"spooled","direct_attempted":true}` with no reason. Root cause was only reachable by reconstructing the child env by hand and invoking `~/.local/share/openbrain-memory/.venv/bin/openbrain-memory` directly, which exposed the package receipt error: `session_start result did not prove exact Open Brain scope: namespace` (exact-scope runtime from #294 correctly rejecting a token whose clientId was not the requested namespace). That is a config problem an operator should be able to see from the public receipt.

## Proposal

Add a bounded, content-free `error_category` to the public receipt for non-saved statuses — a small closed enum, never free text, e.g.:

- `scope-proof-failed` (exact-scope session_start rejection)
- `http-auth` (401/403)
- `http-error` (other non-2xx)
- `network` (connect/timeout)
- `spool-full`
- `invalid-request`

Mapping happens in the adapter from the package receipt's sanitized error string; unknown → `other`. No hostnames, no bodies, no token material — the category alone would have turned a multi-step SSH diagnosis into a one-look answer.

## Refs

- #294 (exact-scope runtime whose rejections currently surface as bare `spooled`)
- Development repo PR #37 (0.1.9 adapter re-pin — where the receipt shape lives)
